title: Cost of the LCFs' meaning: the free side's TD3+BC seeds 2 to 9 continued to the chosen 300,000 updates
description: Continues seeds 2 to 9 of the free side's chosen configuration, TD3+BC at alpha 2.5 behind seven free latents (lcftd-free-a2.5), from the 150,000-update learners saved in exp-lcf-cost-final-seeds-343 to the 300,000 updates that exp-lcf-cost-budget-search-342 chose on links 0 to 99 (net2_resume: every weight, optimizer moment and random state carried over, so each run ends as one 300,000-update run would; seeds 0 and 1 are in exp-lcf-cost-budget-2-341). Every other setting is unchanged, and the network is expliCCit's encoder-decoder exactly, the same as the meaningful side's. No third stage follows: the last doubling gained 0.06 on links 0 to 99, below the 0.1 that extends an edge. summary.md lists each policy's training diagnostics.
run: N="$IN/n/$(cat "$IN/n/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; A="$IN/a/$CFG-n150k-s$SEED"; [ -f "$A/learner.pt" ] && [ -f "$A/train.json" ]; O="$OUT/$CFG-n300k-s$SEED"; mkdir -p "$O"; jq --arg d "$IN/d" --arg n "$N" --arg r "$A/learner.pt" '.data = [$d] | .net1_from = $n | .net2_resume = $r | .save_learner = false | .net2.steps = 300000' "$A/train.json" > "$O/train.json"; uv run expliccit train run "$O/train.json" "$O"; rm -f "$O/net1.pt"
collect: { echo "| policy | transitions | validation BC error | seconds | final diagnostics |"; echo "|---|---|---|---|---|"; for r in "$OUT"/lcft*/report.json; do echo "| $(basename "$(dirname "$r")") | $(jq -r '[.net2.transitions, .net2.val_bc_mse, (.net2.seconds | floor), (.net2.final | to_entries | map("\(.key) \(.value | tostring | .[0:7])") | join(", "))] | join(" | ")' "$r") |"; done; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
